Now GCD(36,48): 48 mod 36 = 12. 36 mod 12 = 0. So GCD=12.

Then GCD(72,96) = 2*12 = 24. Check: 72 mod 24 = 0, 96 mod 24 = 0. Yes.

So answer: GCD(45,60)=15, GCD(90,120)=30; GCD(36,48)=12, GCD(72,96)=24.
